title: The Three Generals of the Penalty Hall
summary: Mu Chen secures the third and final spot to challenge the Three Generals of the Penalty Hall after killing the Spirit King. Shen Cangsheng and Li Xuantong brief him on Gu Tianyan (Heavenly Flame Divine Art), Zhou Qingshan (Invincible Divine Art, never beaten at the same level) and Lin Zheng, a former first on the Heavenly Ranking. At the camp market Mu Chen buys Luo Li a stone for 200,000; it is a Divine Forging Stone, and she uses it to break the first of three seals Luo Tianshen placed on the Luo Divine Sword. In the first round Li Xuantong accepts Zhou Qingshan's ten-move rule, loses his senses to an illusion, and breaks it with a five-tone, five-element sword; Zhou concedes. Shen Cangsheng then beats Lin Zheng with a feint that costs him a light arm injury and is hailed as the true No. 1 of North Heaven. Mu Chen steps up against Gu Tianyan: Heavenly Flame Dragon Halberd against the Black Tortoise Divine Seal.
